text.en: Canadians liked John Buchan, the 1st Baron Tweedsmuir, as their Governor General. He held the post from 1935 to 1940.
text.fr: Les Canadiens appréciaient John Buchan, 1er baron Tweedsmuir, comme gouverneur général. Il a occupé ce poste de 1935 à 1940.

source.quote: John Buchan, the 1st Baron Tweedsmuir, was a popular Governor General of Canada (1935-40).

text.en: Buchan believed newcomer groups should hold on to what makes them themselves, and that each one should add something to the character of the country.
text.fr: Buchan croyait que les groupes d'immigrants devaient garder ce qui fait leur caractère propre et que chacun devait apporter quelque chose au caractère national.

source.quote: Immigrant groups, he said, “should retain their individuality and each make its contribution to the national character.”

text.en: Some people who come to Canada have lived through war or fighting in the place they left.
text.fr: Certaines personnes qui viennent au Canada ont vécu la guerre ou des conflits là d'où elles viennent.

source.quote: Some Canadians immigrate from places where they have experienced warfare or conflict.

text.en: Hard experiences in another country are no reason to bring violent, extreme or hateful prejudice to Canada.
text.fr: Des expériences difficiles vécues ailleurs ne justifient pas d'apporter au Canada des préjugés violents, extrêmes ou haineux.

source.quote: Such experiences do not justify bringing to Canada violent, extreme or hateful prejudices.

text.en: Over many generations, people of British background — and people from other groups too — put in their work and bore hardship to lay this country's foundations.
text.fr: Au fil de nombreuses générations, des gens d'origine britannique — et des gens d'autres groupes aussi — ont travaillé et enduré des épreuves pour poser les fondations du pays.

source.quote: Generations of pioneers and builders of British origins, as well as other groups, invested and endured hardship in laying the foundations of our country.
